articles.title: Strive acquires 1,109 bitcoin, raising total holdings to 16,500 coins
articles.snippet: ASST climbs 133% in three months as Strive grows holdings to 16,500 BTC and explores fresh capital raising options.

articles.title: Bitcoin risks another lower high as stocks rally, AI tokens outperform
articles.snippet: The bitcoin price chart is forming a potential lower high while ether languishes in a months-old range even as S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 index futures push higher.

articles.title: XRP slips below $1.35 after triangle breakdown puts focus on $1.30 support
articles.snippet: XRP lost a key support zone after another failed breakout attempt, with traders now watching whether the months-long compression pattern resolves lower.

articles.title: Ethereum treasury firms lean on staking as ETF pressure builds: Report
articles.snippet: Everstake said staking made up 60% of disclosed revenue among six Ethereum treasury firms, while loss-making companies posted $1.41 billion in losses.

articles.title: Ethereum price chart targets $1.8K as total value locked hits 13-month lows
articles.snippet: Ether price eyes a 14% drop to $1,800 as it trades in a classic bearish pattern amid declining total value locked on the Ethereum network.
